name: Flow-Judge-v0.1
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 131072). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-26. A finetune of microsoft/Phi-3.5-mini-instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 3.821 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2024-09-15. CAVEATS: judge models are scored on the vendor's own held-out judge sets; a judge beating its own base on judge agreement is close to tautological and does not say it is a better chat model. Baseline Phi-3.5-mini is used untuned as a judge (zero-shot), which flatters the comparison. Card prints no size for the held-out sets.
